iconicAnchor.label: National Quilt Collection pieced block and border systems
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The Smithsonian collection demonstrates how piecing, appliqué, blocks, borders, fabric history, and quilting techniques create varied systems within the broad quilt form.

sources.title: National Quilt Collection
supports: Quilts combine layered construction with piecing, appliqué, embroidery, weaving, block patterns, borders, and maker-specific material choices.

sources.title: Nine-patch Postage Stamp quilt
supports: A regimented nine-patch center and precise star and calico borders show how modular repetition and containment organize visual movement.
